title: Add scoped-delegated live coverage matrix
summary: Signed capabilities have broad scoped-delegated paths, but there is no single artifact tracking which paths have live test coverage versus only mock coverage. Add a coverage matrix (docs + validator) that enumerates the scoped-delegated action grammar and pairs each entry with its live test pointer (if any), so the autonomy loop can target the gaps deterministically.
expectedFailureModes: The matrix exists but disagrees with the test tree on names, so it falsely reports coverage that was deleted.
Validator is added but skipped from validate.sh, so the matrix silently drifts.
docs/status.md cites the matrix before it is wired up, overclaiming live coverage.
nextAction: Add docs/signed-capabilities-live-coverage.md enumerating each scoped-delegated action with its live test pointer (or 'gap'), implement a validator that compares the matrix to existing live_ test files under crates/covenantd/tests, and link from docs/status.md.
